headline: Samsung Foundry authors add write-time and write-voltage variation to an MRAM SystemVerilog model
fact: Samsung Foundry authors report a SystemVerilog embedded-MRAM behavior model that incorporates write-time and write-voltage variation into bit-cell test behavior. The reported simulations exercise random write time and voltage-dependent intended write failures, and the authors state that the variation-aware operation was verified with the Digital Nonvolatile-memory Assist IP used to control the MRAM for IP validation.

sources.title: Variation-Aware Modeling Method for MRAM Behavior Model using System-Verilog
sources.summary: The Samsung Foundry paper describes the variation-aware SystemVerilog MRAM model, its write-time and write-voltage modes, and verification with the DNA IP for pre-silicon validation.
